title: feat(mwb): add option to reverse remote scroll direction on remote machines

proposed_comments.body:
### Name the message identifier distinctly from flags

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking naming clarification: this parameter is compared with the `WM_MOUSEWHEEL` message identifier, not tested as a bit mask. Naming it `messageId` makes the helper contract explicit without changing the existing event payload or scroll behavior. Current production and test callers pass it positionally, so the rename does not require changing the transport field named `dwFlags`.

```suggestion
    internal static int ApplyReverse(int wheelDelta, bool reverse, int messageId)
    {
        return reverse && messageId == WM.WM_MOUSEWHEEL ? -wheelDelta : wheelDelta;
```

confidence.rationale: Exact current source supports this explicitly non-blocking clarification; existing guards and caller behavior are preserved.
